cohort: All junctions as source identities and eligible sensors in the pinned EPA Net2 corpus; all hourly samples from zero through 82800 seconds.

numeric_representation_edition.rule: Round every raw signal coordinate to 12 decimal places with ties to even; independently recompute through exact integer arithmetic. Preserve raw bytes and all original source/time/sensor identities and other metadata.
numeric_representation_edition.nonselective: No clipping, omitted coordinates or threshold-based choice of which values to transform; fail if any exact change or post-transform range requirement is violated.
numeric_representation_edition.scope: New finite numerical representation prospectively selected before Net2 acquisition; no physical or simulator-error guarantee and no qualification of original Net3 raw data.

sample_drift: Arbitrary time-varying sample offset relative to the reference; absolute value bounded by the declared D independently at each sample. Reference measurement noise and every sample noise remain bounded by plus/minus one percentage point.
endpoint: Every source pair incompatible after every permitted selected-sensor erasure under exact interval arithmetic, or return the complete unresolved count and a reproducible ambiguity witness.
benefit_rule: Old zero-drift plan has at least one exact ambiguity under a nonzero prespecified D; revised plan has none at that same D and passes fresh actual runtime cases. All five levels reported.
conventional_control: Independently formulate binary multicover from exact pair relations, solve through SciPy/HiGHS with a 20-second limit and zero requested relative gap, and independently verify the returned subset. Solver-reported optimum is not an externally certified integer proof. Shared solver is disclosed.
protected_case_design: Same generated latent offsets, reference errors, sample errors and drift values across arms for each D. Two boundary schedules and two rational random schedules per source; zero or one known selected-sensor erasure. No truth label is provided to candidate runtime.
case_exposure: Generate only after public freeze of successor/checker/parent source and protocols; Net2 contents are uninspected at source freeze. Final cases are never used for a repair retaining their confirmation status.
reproduction: The --replay-seed argument accepts an already exposed 64-character lowercase hexadecimal seed. All checks and cohorts remain identical, but output is labeled EXPOSED_REPRODUCTION_NO_NEW_CONFIRMATION and new_protected_latent_worlds is zero. Default execution generates a fresh seed after the public source freeze.
decision: Finite engineering transfer check, not field validation, novelty confirmation, observed demand or after-cost discovery advantage. Research-funded until a separate economic gate qualifies actual unrestricted simulated earnings.
